posts.cooked:
Oh Captain, My Captain - ROUND 1 - Dawn of a New Day

New comers!  Give them a warm welcome to the new order my fellow citizens!

Villain Turn (Citizen Dawn - Leader)
Start -
  No citizens in villain trash; Citizen Dawn does not flip

Play - Luminous Leadership (on-going)

End -
 - Citizen Dawn deals 4 Energy damage to Sky-Scraper [29]
 - Citizen Winter deals 3 Cold damage to each hero target:
   Guise [24], Captain Cosmic [24], Tempest [24], Sky-Scraper [26], Scholar [26]
 - Citizen Tears makes each player discard 1 card (...)
 - Citizen Hammer deals 4 Fire damage to each hero target:
   Guise [20], Captain Cosmic [20], Tempest [20], Sky-scraper [22], Scholar [22]

=======
Effects:
- Increase damage dealt by citizens by 1 (Citizen Dawn - Leader - advanced)
- Reduce damage dealt to citizens by 1 (Citizen Anvil)

- At the start of the villain turn if there are five or more citizens in the villain trash, flip Citizen Dawn's villain character cards.  She may only flip once this way per game. (Citizen Dawn - Leader)
- At the start of the villain turn, each citizen regains 1 HP (Luminous Leadership)

- At the end of the villain turn, Citizen Dawn deals the hero target with the highest HP 3 Energy damage. (Citizen Dawn - Leader)
- At the end of the villain turn, Citizen Winter deals each hero target 2 Cold damage. (Citizen Winter)
- At the end of the villain turn, each player discards one card (Citizen Tears)
- If Citizen Sweat is in play, each player discards one card (Citizen Tears)
- If Citizen Blood is in play, Citizen Tears deals each hero melee damage equal to the number of cards discarded by their player this turn (Citizen Tears)
- At the end of the villain turn, if Citizen Hammer is in the villain trash, put him into play. (Citizen Anvil)
- At the end of the villain turn, Citizen Hammer deals each hero target 3 Fire damage (Citizen Hammer)


Status
======
Citizen Dawn  [80] (citizen)(Leader)(-1)
Citizen Winter [4] (citizen)(-1)
Citizen Tears  [5] (citizen)(-1)
Citizen Anvil  [7] (citizen)(-1)
Citizen Hammer [3] (citizen)(-1)

Luminous Leadership (on-going)

Villain Trash: None

-------
Guise           [20] (tie: low HP)
Captain Cosmic  [20] (tie: low HP)
Tempest         [20] (tie: low HP)
Sky-Scraper     [22] (tie: high HP)
Scholar         [22] (tie: high HP)

------- Environment --------
None


Comments:

Let the carnage begin.  And each player needs to discard a card.

posts.name: RanisTheSlayer
posts.cooked:
Guise drops his phone. It's a camera too. Don't judge.

"Hey guys, can I join in? No? Aww, c'mon! I'm gonna be a thousand times more helpful than that guy whose superpower is holding a MacGuffin!"
Guise flexes. Yes, it's totally cool.
 

Guise

HP:  20

Hand:  Total Beefcake, Gritty Reboot, Selling Out, Say Cheese!

In Play: --

Trash: ---------------------------

Start of Turn: Guise discards Say Cheese! because Citizen Tears is a poopyhead.

Play a Card:  Total Beefcake. Who would want to hurt such beauty?

Use a Power:  Tough Choices....which to choose? I'll draw a card! Yay, the Best Card Ever! And punch Anvil for...nothing? Aww, that's lame! [1-1] 0 damage! The worst kind!

Draw a Card:  Uh, Yeah, I'm That Guy!

End of Turn: ---------------------------

HP:  20

Hand:  Uh, Yeah, I'm That Guy!, Best Card Ever!, Gritty Reboot, Selling Out

In Play: Total Beefcake

Trash:  Say Cheese!

Effects:  The first time Guise would be dealt damage each turn, redirect that damage to the non-hero target with the lowest HP.

 

Comments:

So what's the plan here, folks? Are we going to try to kill Dawn without flipping her?
